title: Van der Waals constant b
description: Essential: Correctly expresses b in terms of molecular diameter d, i.e., b = N_A * d^3.

title: Critical constants relation
description: Essential: Correctly expresses van der Waals constants a and b in terms of critical temperature T_c and pressure P_c.

title: Numerical constants for water
description: Essential: Correctly calculates numerical values for a_w and b_w using given T_c and P_c.

title: Gas volume expression
description: Important: Correctly derives and expresses the gas volume V_G using the van der Waals equation and appropriate root selection.

title: Liquid volume and density
description: Important: Correctly expresses the liquid volume V_L and derives the liquid density ρ_L in terms of given parameters.

title: Thermal expansion coefficient
description: Important: Correctly expresses and evaluates the volume thermal expansion coefficient α for liquid water.

title: Latent heat expression
description: Important: Correctly expresses the specific heat of vaporization L in terms of given parameters and evaluates it.

title: Surface tension estimation
description: Optional: Correctly estimates the surface tension σ from the monomolecular layer model.

title: Pressure over curved surface
description: Important: Correctly derives the pressure change Δp_T for a curved liquid-vapor interface.

title: Droplet radius calculation
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the minimum droplet radius from the given temperature change and data.

title: Root selection error
description: Pitfall: Uses the incorrect (minus) root for V_G or V_L when the physical (plus for V_G, minus for V_L) root is required.

title: Unit or constant misuse
description: Pitfall: Fails to use consistent SI units or misapplies constants (R, N_A, μ) in calculations.
